name: @konum/backend
description: Konum Firebase backend (Faz 1–6): kurallar (Firestore, RTDB, Storage), Cloud Functions ve emülatör testleri.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm --prefix functions run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-konum --only auth,firestore,database,functions,storage "vitest run"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-konum --only firestore,database,storage "vitest run test/rules test/unit"
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-konum
